snippet.title: Friday Night Funkin - Mobile Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Friday Night Funkin is now available on mobile:

Apple App Store - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/friday-night-funkin-mobile/id6740428530

Google Play Store - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=me.funkin.fnf

The internet rhythm hit with over 200,000,000+ plays has been brought to phones with love. Experience the bizarre shared love of Boyfriend and Girlfriend through 50+ songs, now enhanced with haptics and refined gameplay. With new story updates on the horizon, there's never been a better time to jump in.


TRAILER BY PHANTOMARCADE
WITH MUSIC BY THISISCUB & SETAI
SAMPLES PERMITTED BY ERIC DOA
